summary: Both production sweep copies silently swallow housekeeping failures instead of emitting the required bounded skip diagnostic.
The gotcha overstates EXIT/INT/TERM trap protection even though SIGKILL cannot run a shell trap.
Both sweeps delete at exactly 3600 seconds despite the plan’s strict older-than-60-minutes predicate.
The duplicated pod-guard sweep lacks a per-file unlink-error regression test.
